note: Inyo County campground on Tinnemaha Creek in the Owens Valley south of Big Pine, on an open flat beside the creek's cottonwood belt; on the county map sites 2-15 line the creek bank, 16-30 sit on the outer dirt loop. --Claude
summary: County page + county site map + imagery read. Confirmed $14, extra vehicle $5, no hookups, vault toilets; added 35 spaces, no potable water, no showers, 6 people a site, FCFS some sites beside ReserveAmerica. Creekside kept (sites 2-15 on the bank). Rock Fire closure lifted. Season not posted.
flags: WATERFRONT: creekside kept. County map (Tinnemaha.pdf, 2025-05) draws sites 2-15 strung along the creek's east bank; on Esri the open site flat abuts the creek's riparian band (creek a few metres wide under cottonwoods, so creek-sized - creekside is the right class). Per-site lengths are not published, so which of 2-15 take a 23-ft rig is unknown ('Camping spaces available for larger RV's'). Not an --AWH value.
